question: When is the festival of Ram Navami celebrated in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ninth day of Chaitra month**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Ram Navami is celebrated on the **ninth day of the Chaitra month** as per the Hindu lunar calendar.

• This day marks the **birth anniversary of Lord Rama**, who is the seventh incarnation of Lord Vishnu.

• It usually falls in the Gregorian months of **March or April** every year.

• Ram Navami is a significant festival for Hindus and is celebrated with great devotion and enthusiasm, especially in places associated with the life of Lord Rama, such as Ayodhya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Chaitra Month**

• Chaitra is the first month in the Hindu lunar calendar, which begins the day after the new moon in the month of March or April.

• It is one of the most auspicious months in the Hindu calendar, and many important festivals are celebrated during this month, including Chaitra Navratri and Ram Navami.

• Chaitra Navratri is a nine-day festival dedicated to the worship of Goddess Durga, and Ram Navami is celebrated on the ninth day of this festival.

• **Lord Rama**

• Lord Rama is one of the most revered deities in Hinduism and is considered the epitome of virtue and righteousness.

• He is the protagonist of the Hindu epic Ramayana, which narrates his life story, including his birth, exile, the abduction of his wife Sita by Ravana, and his eventual victory over Ravana.

• Lord Rama is worshipped as an avatar of Lord Vishnu, and his life and teachings are celebrated and followed by millions of devotees.

• **Ayodhya**

• Ayodhya is an ancient city located in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh and is believed to be the birthplace of Lord Rama.

• It is one of the seven most important pilgrimage sites (Sapta Puri) for Hindus and holds great religious significance.

• The city witnesses grand celebrations and processions during Ram Navami, attracting devotees from all over the country.
